title: SQLite stays a derived read cache, never the source of truth
state: accepted

edges:
  - type: derives_from
    to: int-0002
alternatives:
  - option: SQLite as the source of truth, with git storing the .db file
    why_not: >
      a binary blob in git is unreviewable and unmergeable, and breaks the
      property that the record is human-readable text you can git log -p
      without dira installed
  - option: no cache at all, parse every entry file on every query
    why_not: >
      fine at a few dozen entries but fails int-0002's felt-latency bar
      once a ledger reaches the low thousands, and dira brief must return
      in well under 100ms on a cold cache
source:
  hook: manual
  tier: human
confirmed_by: human
---

The SQLite cache under `.dira/cache/` is gitignored and rebuilt by
`dira reindex` from the entry files at any time; if the cache and the files
disagree, the files win. This keeps SQLite as a derived database file
rather than the ledger's source of truth. Fixture entry for
`internal/enforcer`.
